outcome: barriers to seeking medical consultation for UI (embarrassment, logistical inconvenience, provider-related issues, fear-related barriers, cultural concerns)
cohort: The study included 505 individuals aged 18 years and above in Saudi Arabia who experienced urinary incontinence but had not sought medical consultation.
finding: The most significant barriers deterring healthcare-seeking among UI patients in Saudi Arabia were embarrassment, logistical inconvenience, and provider-related issues, with gender, obesity, residency region, and UI type significantly influencing barrier perception.
